The '''revenant imp''' is a type of monster, that inhabits the [[Forinthry Dungeon]], along with all other [[revenants]]. The Forinthry Dungeon is a part of the [[Wilderness]] so it is possible to be attacked by other players here if opted into [[PvP]].

Like all revenants, they can restore lifepoints quickly, can cure themselves of poison and react quickly to a player's protection prayers. When below 50% health, revenant imps will "eat" to heal 250 lifepoints from their limited supply of food. For a full description of the healing mechanic see the [[Revenants#Overview|revenants]] page.

==Drops==
{{DropLogProject|jagex=yes}}

Revenant drops are not affected by [[luck]]. There are only two ways to increase the drop rate of revenant items: completion of the [[elite Wilderness achievements]] which gives a 5% increased chance for revenant drops, and [[revenant drop enhancer]]s, which give a 10% increased chance. Both boosts can be in effect at the same time.

==Trivia==
* The examine for a revenant imp is slightly different from most other revenants (excluding revenant [[Revenant hellhound|hellhounds]], [[Revenant pyrefiend|pyrefiends]], [[Revenant icefiend|icefiends]], and [[Revenant demon|demons]]). Its examine says that it is the ''essence'' of an imp slain during the [[God Wars]], as opposed to the ''ghost'' of an imp slain during the God Wars. These five revenants are similar in that they are all demonic.
